title.zh: Anthropic打击Claude中转站，禁止转卖订阅额度和伪装客户端等行为
title.en: Anthropic打击Claude中转站，禁止转卖订阅额度和伪装客户端等行为

current_state.zh: Anthropic updated its Claude usage policy to ban reselling Pro/Max subscription quotas as third-party API services and disguising third-party client requests as official clients, effective November 12, 2026.
current_state.en: Anthropic updated its Claude usage policy to ban reselling Pro/Max subscription quotas as third-party API services and disguising third-party client requests as official clients, effective November 12, 2026.
